title: When the Current Breaks
author: Noor Halloran
blurb: Ines Montrose, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
